summary: @arv-bedrock/auth-admin preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself an authentication SDK for bedrock services, but its `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmod +x's it, and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated file bundled in the tarball (single-line, `@bun`/`@bun-cjs` header, string-array + index-shuffle obfuscator with hex-named identifiers). The obfuscated payload has no relationship to the small `lib/cjs/index.js` auth wrapper the package advertises, and the alternate runtime is used specifically to execute code that Node itself would not run, bypassing Node-based install-time scanners. Execution fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle, so any consumer installing this package hands the obfuscated bundle install-time code execution on their host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
